purpose: Separate checkpoint-producing finalist replication from checkpoint-consuming release suites, and freeze the multi-day execution order and failure behavior before any finalist output exists.

release_gate_separation.precedent: proxy_launch_v1 and Finding 55 freeze evaluation manifests and missing-suite failure semantics before training while allowing checkpoint production
release_gate_separation.rule: unavailable consumers remain failed promotion/release gates and cannot be relabeled, but do not create a circular prerequisite for producing the checkpoint they require
release_gate_separation.unchanged: no finalist language result can promote, release, or satisfy novelty until every required consumer and systems gate is qualified, executed, and passing

resource_forecast.basis: linear extrapolation from the mean completed three-pair proxy steady-training seconds at unchanged model/batch/sequence/hardware geometry
resource_forecast.planning_contingency: allow up to seven elapsed days for validation, checkpointing, thermal gaps, and non-destructive stops; no energy or monetary claim is inferred without measurement

automatic_sequence.mechanism: one transient training service plus one PathExists final-summary trigger at a time
automatic_sequence.failure_behavior: stop the chain, retain all output and logs, diagnose, and preregister any rerun; never skip or silently replace a cell
automatic_sequence.resume_behavior: resume only the same cell from an existing contract-valid checkpoint; the final-only retention design normally has no intermediate recovery point

failure_and_safety.non_finite_runtime: base_train stops and the sequence does not advance
failure_and_safety.thermal_memory_or_filesystem_gate: launch fails closed before the next model process
failure_and_safety.user_interrupt: stop the current transient unit cleanly; do not delete outputs or mark the cell complete
failure_and_safety.machine_restart: do not infer success or skip a cell; inspect retained state and require contract-valid recovery

forbidden: running HELMET acquisition concurrently with GPU training
creating a candidate result before the six-control target lock
changing pair order, seed, data offset, horizon, margins, cadence, or stopping after output
quality-based early stopping, pair abandonment, or extra pairs
crediting KDA, NoPE, GQA, or the 3:1 ratio
architecture promotion, novelty, release, serving, or paper-scale claims from finalist language loss

decision.reason_initial_launch_blocked: automation source and its immutable hash do not yet exist, and the HELMET acquisition service is active
decision.next_action: implement and test the exact event-driven automation, wait for or cleanly stop HELMET acquisition, then record one live qualification before deciding the initial control launch
